definitions.explanation: An object used for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: {道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片|かた}づける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。

⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧{道具|どうぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}して→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put cleaning tools back in their proper place after using them.

notes:
{道具|どうぐ} is a general term for tools, implements, and equipment used for specific purposes.

TYPES:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧{道具|どうぐ}: cooking utensils
- ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧{道具|どうぐ}: carpentry tools
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧{道具|どうぐ}: cleaning tools
- ⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧: stationery (writing tools)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use tools
- {道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to gather/prepare tools
- {道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片|かた}づける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to put away tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工具|こうぐ}→工具：01401_kougu⟧: mechanical/industrial tools
- ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: instruments, apparatus
- ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧: equipment, supplies

{道具|どうぐ} is the broadest term, covering everything from kitchen utensils to craft supplies.
